PLAN THE WORK

A useful description makes a better starting point.

Note the boiler make and model, the exact error message and whether the problem affects heating, hot water or both. Explain when it started and whether it happens all the time or only at particular points.

Do not remove the casing or attempt work on gas components. If you suspect a gas leak or carbon monoxide problem, use the official emergency guidance rather than waiting for an online enquiry.

A repair may depend on diagnosis and parts availability. If replacement is worth considering, ask for the reasons and compare the scope of both options before deciding.

THINGS TO DISCUSS

Make the brief clear.

  • Make and model
  • Error message or displayed code
  • Heating, hot water or both
  • When the problem began

GOOD TO KNOW

Your questions,
answered.

Do you offer a 24-hour emergency service?

An around-the-clock service is not advertised here. Confirm availability directly. Do not use this website to report a suspected gas emergency.

Can every boiler be repaired?

That depends on the fault, condition of the appliance and availability of suitable parts. An assessment is needed.
